The '''mission''' to [[Argovia]] was a rebel mission to destroy the [[Imperial Sensor Net Complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[Blockade of the Endocray sector|blockaded]] the [[Endocray sector/Legends|Endocray sector]], suspecting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity in the area.<ref name="TAS" />

==The mission==
The Rebel Alliance launched an operation to destroy the [[Imperial Sensor Net Complex|blockade control center]] on Argovia. The cargo ship [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Leona Makk]] managed in forcing the blockade and drove an Alliance strike team to the planet. On Argovia, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Battz]] gave them hacked ID card to access the complex. The rebels managed in penetrating discreetly the center and placed explosives to destroy it.<ref name="TAS" />

==Aftermath==
After the destruction of the center, the Imperials couldn't maintain efficiently the blockade and the Endocray sector was reopened.<ref name="TAS" />
